name: Coldspot
description: Inhabits climate systems and creates localized temperature drops — a room that's always three degrees colder than it should be, a corridor with a permanent draft.
observed_behavior: Redirects thermal energy away from specific zones. The missing heat goes somewhere — possibly to Blanket's warm rooms.
story_hooks: Someone maps every Coldspot and Blanket zone in the Shelf and realizes they form a thermal redistribution network — the E.L.F.s are cooperating
